reasons: Conflicting constraints: CS4221 and CS2105 must be in the same semester, but also cannot be together.

CS4221 requires CS3223, which requires CS2040S/CS2040 and CS2102. CS2102 requires CS2030S and CS2040S/CS2040. CS2105 requires CS2040S/CS2040. CS2106 requires CS2100. CS3231 requires CS1231 and CS2040S/CS2040. The logical contradiction regarding CS4221 and CS2105 makes a valid plan impossible.
